author: Sandy Powell
text: Absolutely amazing!!  Josh came at, right on time!    Explained what he was doing.  Around 30 minutes later, job completed.  Great communication, excellent customer service,   will tell everyone how amazing this company is.

author: Bee Vang
text: My septic tank was full and backed clogged  all the way to the house. I called a few places but no one can come out and they are booked for weeks out. Thanks Google search, I got a hold of Bub’s. They showed up 2 hrs later and got the job done. Best price and excellent service…

author: Derric Abrecht
text: Well done.  I was very happy with the punctuality, service, and job.  I highly recommend Bub's Inc. when you need septic pumping services. Josh was very knowledgeable and professional in everything he did.

author: D. Kelly
text: Called on Wednesday because I knew we were overdue for a septic Cleanout. Was there first thing next day, took care of everything promptly and very reasonably. Josh was very friendly too. Highly recommend.
